newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bradford cuts Apple South.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bradford cuts Apple South.

text.p: J.C. Bradford analyst Barry Stouffer said he lowered his recommendation on Apple South Inc to neutral from buy on Wednesday following the company's warning of an earnings shortfall.

"We reduced our rating from buy to neutral, just because we think the stock will recover a little and then trade sideways until visibility improves, which we think will take six to nine months," said Stouffer.
As he spoke, Apple South stock was off 7-7/8 at 13 on the Nasdaq market.
